useCases.title: Run OpenCode through AnyRouter
useCases.summary: Add an AnyRouter provider to OpenCode
useCases.problem: OpenCode's built-in providers each want their own key. Switching models or sharing billing with Claude Code and Codex means editing every tool separately.
steps: Create an AnyRouter key in the dashboard (sk-ar-…), or let the CLI sign you in.
Launch with anyr opencode so it injects the provider for that session, or add AnyRouter to opencode.json for a persistent config.
Pick an anyrouter/… model in /models and confirm the call in request logs.
